test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 28 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Choose the dice from the given options that is similar to the dice formed from the given sheet of paper (X). 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e0373160601acba7b1634cce49b13a98cf7cf214aa0384dec497fbe77ef3460.png]
solution:
The folding the paper cutting along the lines to make a cubical box is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb3ded3e21c66eb06b9dc76654c34f579004665fe2101091f40ebb6b49122d61.png] 

⇒ As the alternate positions become opposite to each other, the remaining two faces become opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a43d4f0fd0bb6f4e704e24d12704b268e9123cb3d4065427db134f075c24c8c2.png] → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9009a0a7995e41da4f8d50b7d08c6f2aa70607bd1e735633ca1765c008b86033.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3651f18e8c0f238433053f15437dfb6912343469faa699b998a7f19666c8a187.png] → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3651f18e8c0f238433053f15437dfb6912343469faa699b998a7f19666c8a187.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1da31c4b36b0d79f22a17fea0b5c3fd16b9f0de41750c9995c97fe61a3962462.png] → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/806d0801197d41847584b24a5e5a9e5487d69eefffc7ce8b4504d3eb4d1a6821.png] 

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abfffe580478541e74c3ab21e3d2eaa1f4d2691d1c2ddd166a02ff2a4fbd1293.png] ⇒ Cannot be made because [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9009a0a7995e41da4f8d50b7d08c6f2aa70607bd1e735633ca1765c008b86033.png] is adjacent to [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a43d4f0fd0bb6f4e704e24d12704b268e9123cb3d4065427db134f075c24c8c2.png] .

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ee7bed5d31c367e558fe3de6399e91ae912be3faa49d6827ccfbaa61640f8ff.png] ⇒Cannot be made because [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1da31c4b36b0d79f22a17fea0b5c3fd16b9f0de41750c9995c97fe61a3962462.png] is adjacent to [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/806d0801197d41847584b24a5e5a9e5487d69eefffc7ce8b4504d3eb4d1a6821.png] ​.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13c195d0c9d9c2e834677b8701fb9df8448a04e053c32556908e2d6d90906739.png] ⇒ Cannot be made because [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1da31c4b36b0d79f22a17fea0b5c3fd16b9f0de41750c9995c97fe61a3962462.png] is adjacent to [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/806d0801197d41847584b24a5e5a9e5487d69eefffc7ce8b4504d3eb4d1a6821.png] .

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77c9844a1186309dff1af6c890302be169a04fd319fca457247a5f8a4bc02f4c.png] ⇒ Can be made because all are the opposite sides.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
